svg.aria-label: Original nuclear-induction schematic connects field, specimen, radiofrequency coil and reception, illustrating the physical relationship central to the 1946 work. The right panel uses the approximate proton gyromagnetic ratio; 9.4 T gives 400.22 MHz without specimen-specific electronic-shielding corrections.
